overview: Liverpool finished fourth in the Premier League with 76 points and reached the Champions League semi-final. Fernando Torres arrived from Atlético Madrid and scored 33 competitive goals, including 24 in the league. He was the first Liverpool player since Robbie Fowler in 1996–97 to reach 30 goals in a season.

After taking one point from their first three Champions League group matches, Liverpool won the next three, including an 8–0 victory over Beşiktaş at Anfield. They then beat Internazionale and Arsenal before Chelsea won the semi-final 4–3 on aggregate. The home quarter-final against Arsenal finished 4–2 to Liverpool.

Yossi Benayoun, Ryan Babel and Lucas Leiva also joined, with Martin Škrtel arriving in January. A permanent deal was completed for Javier Mascherano during the season. Barnsley knocked Liverpool out of the FA Cup in the fifth round, while Chelsea ended their League Cup run in the quarter-final. Liverpool finished without a trophy.
